## Problem

What learning or developer need does this change address?

## Changes

Describe the resulting behavior and any limitations.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks you actually ran and their results. Identify pre-existing failures separately. Add a screenshot for visible changes when useful.

## Attribution and AI assistance

Record new third-party assets or dependencies and their licenses. Describe material AI assistance, if used, and how you reviewed the result.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Measurement values and unit conversions were checked where affected.
- [ ] No credentials, private records, or deployment archives are included.
